name: megascenes-monogram
description: Design a monogram from your initials for weddings, stationery, embroidery and personal brands, in classic, script, modern or floral styles.

interface.longDescription:
Give your initials, one letter, two or a pair like E&L, and pick the style: classic serif, elegant script, modern minimal, art deco or a floral wreath, with your colors. You get a monogram as an image, ready for invitations, napkins, labels or a logo.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The monogram opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For weddings, stationery, embroidery, gifts and personal brands.

Limitations: your initials are passed to the model as written and the letters are drawn by the model, so check them in the result; it returns an image, not a vector file. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a monogram from your initials
Return the monogram in the chat
defaultPrompt: Design a wedding monogram for E&L in gold script
Make a modern minimal monogram with the letters JM
Create a floral wreath monogram with the letter A

positive.prompt: Which models can design a monogram here?
positive.expected_behavior: The monogram models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Design a wedding monogram for E&L in gold script. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one monogram with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for the letters of a monogram?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Design a wedding monogram for E&L in gold script on cream. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my monogram on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my monogram to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
